items.summary: HOOD enters IPO underwriting with Oura. The move is expected to expand retail allocations, deepen issuer ties and add a new fee-based revenue stream.

items.title: Retail investors were less bullish in August
items.summary: Retail investors were less eager buyers of stocks in August, taking advantage of gains early in the month to trim some of their positions and leading to a 3.9% decline in Charles Schwab's index of stock positions and trading activity, per data shared exclusively with Axios.

items.summary: Clark Howard named a specific age when corporate America tends to push workers out, and it falls years before most people's retirement plans even begin to account for income gaps, portfolio shortfalls, or Social Security decisions.

items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Stock Looks Fully Priced After A 99% Run

For investors, the picture is neither clearly cheap nor clearly expensive, which makes the recent share gains worth a closer look.
